name: damitv-hls-proxy
description: Self-hosted DamiTV catalog and HLS proxy — live sports events, sanctioned embeds, referer-aware stream relay

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.client.json && cp src/client/index.html src/client/styles.css dist/client/ && rm -rf dist/embed/wasm && cp -R src/embed/wasm dist/embed/wasm
